content:
marco: Rolling the Clarity Beacon pricing micro-slate to staging tonight. Need FAQ microcopy, calculator flow, and inbound routing rules before soft launch. :satellite:
elaine: Short FAQ only — 3 bullets: billing, commitments, security. Each 1 line + 'Read more' link. Keep language conversational.
kevin: Tier name option: Base / Team / Committed. Also testing short descriptors under each tier (e.g., 'pay-as-you-go', 'team seats', 'reserved capacity').
sam: Routing: preview users -> SDR queue; email-capture converters -> Growth AE; >$7k signals -> Enterprise AE. Tag: "beacon_estimator".
nina: Calculator behavior: show a 2-line micro-summary (monthly est + p95 latency delta). Clicking "See full breakdown" opens modal asking for email to download PDF and show latency table. Default slider -> 10k tokens/mo.
marco: Include a small benchmark sentence under results: "Representative tests: Hosted ~120ms median, Dedicated <40ms p95" with link to bench doc. Keep cautious wording.
kevin: CTA wording variants: A) "Estimate cost" B) "See price range". We'll A/B test which drives more email captures.
elaine: Also test FAQ placement: inline under price vs compact accordion. Add heatmap tracking on 'Learn more' clicks.
sam: Webhook + tagging plan: create tags beacon_estimator_v1 and webinar_beacon_2026; webhooks -> /hooks/beacon_est and /hooks/webinar_beacon. Include hidden param src=beacon_estimator on lead form.
growth-bot: tags created: beacon_estimator_v1, webinar_beacon_2026. Webhooks configured: /hooks/beacon_est and /hooks/webinar_beacon.
kevin: UX note: partial preview reduces friction. Show preview immediately, request email only for PDF/download.
nina: Events to track: beacon_preview_shown, beacon_email_capture, beacon_submit, faq_expand, faq_learnmore_click, sales_handshake.
marco: Webinar invite list: trials + recent estimator interactions (30d). Sam to handle sends + UTMs.
sam: Will do two sends. UTM: ?utm_source=beacon&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=beacon_launch.
elaine: Copy freeze tomorrow EOD. Want staging QA Wed and soft-launch Thu.
nina: One more microtest: expose latency delta in preview vs hide it and only show in breakdown. We'll measure ops signups.
marco: Great. I'll assemble the launch checklist and tag owners. Ping when copy is final. :white_check_mark:
